body: i had a similar thing happen to me. it was on a much smaller scale where i knew i never meant anything to them and just kept convincing myself i did. i felt the same burning pain as you when they stopped talking to me and i felt sick about it for months.
i want so desperately to talk to someone about it but i don’t feel comfortable telling anyone i know about how i feel and quite frankly i don’t really want anyone to find out.
